subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Plunge
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Dive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"plunge"** means to jump or dive quickly and energetically; it could also refer to falling suddenly and uncontrollably. (गिरना, डुबकी लगाना)

 
 
• **Example:** He decided to plunge into the pool to cool off on a hot summer day.
 
 
 
• **"Dive"** refers to jumping or falling quickly and steeply, often into water. (डुबकी लगाना)
 
 
• **Example:** The children were excited to dive into the lake during their summer camp.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'plunge'** is **'dive'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Dive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Transgress** (अतिक्रमण करना): To go beyond the bounds of a moral principle or other established standard of behavior.

 
 
• **Example:** He had transgressed the unwritten rules of social conduct.
 
 
 
• **Rush** (जल्दी करना): To move with urgent haste.
 
 
• **Example:** She had to rush to catch the last bus home.
 
 
 
• **Fly** (उड़ना): To move through the air using wings.
 
 
• **Example:** The birds fly south for the winter.
